bands.label: Balashikha bombing and aftermath
bands.summary: Damir Davydov is killed by a car bomb in a Moscow suburb on June 10, drone strikes hit the capital region, and the E3 ambassadors meet Russia's deputy foreign minister as Britain seizes a Russian tanker.

bands.label: Serial strikes on senior officers
bands.summary: A pattern of high-profile assassinations inside Russia opens with the December 2024 killing of Lt. Gen. Igor Kirillov and continues through further attacks on military and defense-linked figures.

bands.label: Full-scale war years
bands.summary: Russia's February 2022 invasion of Ukraine reshaped the security picture, drew sanctions, and turned Russian ammunition and logistics commands into named wartime roles.

bands.label: Crimea and Donbas decade
bands.summary: Russia's 2014 annexation of Crimea and the war in eastern Ukraine set the long arc of confrontation with NATO capitals, sanctions regimes, and the diplomatic break that the 2026 Moscow meetings still reference.

frames.label: Jun 10, 2026 Balashikha blast
frames.note: This is the frame Russian state outlets and the Kremlin open with. The story begins as a criminal car bombing on Russian soil that killed Damir Davydov, with the FSB opening a murder probe. Read this way, the situation is a domestic terror incident in a Moscow suburb.

frames.label: Dec 2024 Kirillov killing
frames.note: This is the frame many Western and Ukrainian outlets open with, citing the IBT and Le Monde framing of a one-year pattern. The story begins with the December 2024 car bomb that killed Lt. Gen. Igor Kirillov and reads as the latest entry in a serial campaign of targeted strikes on senior Russian military figures. Read this way, June 2026 is a continuation, not a start.

frames.label: Feb 2022 full-scale invasion
frames.note: This is the frame Kyiv, the E3 envoys in Moscow, and most Ukrainian-aligned analysts open with. The story begins when Russia's full-scale invasion turned military logistics chiefs like Davydov into wartime actors, with assassinations read as battlefield-adjacent operations. Read this way, the Balashikha bomb is one node in a war that started four years earlier.
